Pehchaan Ek Safar · IIT Ropar

Education opened
a door for me.

Being the first in my family to pursue higher education makes that more than a nice sentence. It’s why I care about helping someone else find their way in.

Founding member · Secretary & Social Media / External Affairs Lead, 2018–2019

A journey I’m proud to be part of

Learning needs
room to play.

Sometimes, that room needs crayons.

I’m a founding member and former secretary of Pehchaan Ek Safar, the student-led education initiative at IIT Ropar. Its work supports children from underserved communities around the campus through teaching, help with entering school, and opportunities to learn beyond the classroom.

Paathshala and school outreach are central to that effort. IIT Ropar’s accounts describe volunteers working with families, supporting school admissions, and making room for activities and play alongside lessons. I like that last part. Curiosity deserves some room to run around.

Beyond the timetable

There’s more to it
than the lessons.

A drawing someone wants to show you. A celebration that brings everyone together. The small moments belong in this story too.

These photographs capture a little of that side of Pehchaan Ek Safar: the making, the sharing, and the simple pleasure of being part of something together.

Not everything that matters comes with a grade.
Make room for “why?”

A chance to
try things out.

Perhaps it’s the lifelong tinkerer in me, but I have a soft spot for learning that lets you get your hands involved. Science feels different when you can explore it for yourself.

Why it stays with me

I know what it means to be given a chance to learn. Pehchaan Ek Safar connected that personal experience with something we could do together. It remains a part of my journey that I’m especially proud of.
